description: Mutation sweep over the pinned curve arithmetic -- the three formulas every price in this project is computed from, and the rounding rules that took a full-artifact reproduction to establish. Five modules call these rather than reimplementing them, so a silent change here is a silent change everywhere at once.

mutants.name: ceil_div accepts a non-positive denominator
mutants.old:
if denominator <= 0:
        raise FreezeViolation(f"non-positive denominator {denominator} in exact integer quote")
mutants.new:
if False:
        raise FreezeViolation(f"non-positive denominator {denominator} in exact integer quote")

mutants.name: exact-input buy drops the numerator minus one
exact-input buy drops the denominator minus one
exact-input buy accepts a non-positive input
legacy buy uses ceil instead of floor plus one
legacy buy drops the plus one
legacy buy accepts consuming the whole reserve
sell accepts a negative token input
a non-integer trade quantity is accepted
mutants.old:
if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
            raise FreezeViolation(f"TradeEvent {label} is not a non-negative integer: {value!r}")
mutants.new:
if False:
            raise FreezeViolation(f"TradeEvent {label} is not a non-negative integer: {value!r}")

mutants.name: an unrecognised buy silently uses the exact-input formula
mutants.old:
raise FreezeViolation(
            f"buy instruction {name!r} has no pinned quote arithmetic; exact-input and exact-token "
            "buys use different formulas and must not share one")
mutants.new:
return ("tokens_out",
                tokens_out_for_exact_quote_in(
                    before_virtual_quote, before_virtual_token, quote),
                token)

mutants.name: an unrecognised sell silently uses the sell formula
mutants.old: raise FreezeViolation(f"sell instruction {name!r} has no pinned quote arithmetic")

mutants.name: a legacy buy is priced with the exact-input formula
an exact-input buy is priced with the legacy formula

expected_survivors_note: None expected. The legacy-buy mutant is the sharpest: ceil and floor+1 AGREE on every trade whose division leaves a remainder, so only an exactly-divisible case distinguishes them, and the frozen corpus holds exactly one. B2b's nine samples chose ceil and were wrong for precisely that reason.
